sections.content: You know the *pretérito* *perfecto* from Unit 1: *he*, *has*, *ha*, *hemos* or *han* plus a past participle. Use it again to talk about recent actions of your family: *Mi madre ha llamado*. *Mis padres han hablado*.

items.spanish: Mi padre ha hablado con mi hermana.
items.english: My father has spoken with my sister.
My family has spoken with me.

sections.content: Learn the forms as one chain: *he*, *has*, *ha*, *hemos*, *han*. Only the auxiliary changes with the subject; the participle stays the same: *ha llamado*, *han llamado*.
